sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.
sections.leads: Between two statements in G minor

sections.label: Subject in G minor, rhythm varied (Bass)
Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from the subject. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times).
sections.leads: From G minor to C minor

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 5–6) in part, with the alto's line in the soprano, the tenor's line in the alto, transposed. Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1. Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times). Tenor: a figure from the subject (2 times). Bass: the opening of the subject, inverted.
sections.leads: From C minor to G minor

sections.label: Subject in G minor, rhythm varied (Tenor)
Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 5–6) in part, with the alto's line in the soprano, the tenor's line in the alto, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the tenth). Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: the opening of the subject, inverted. Tenor: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From G minor to C minor

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of the subject. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1. Tenor: a figure from the subject. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From C minor to F minor

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of countersubject 1 and a figure from the subject. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from the subject. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From F minor to E♭ major

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in E♭ major, rhythm varied (Tenor); Subject in E♭ major (Soprano)
Episode 6
sections.summary: Alto: a figure from the subject and the opening of countersubject 1. Tenor: a figure from the subject. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From E♭ major to B♭ major

sections.label: Episode 7
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 5–6) in part, with the alto's line in the tenor, the tenor's line in the bass, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times). Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: the opening of countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From B♭ major to G minor

sections.label: Episode 8
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: the opening of the subject, inverted. Tenor: a figure from the subject. Bass: the opening of the subject.
sections.leads: Between two statements in G minor

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in G minor (Soprano); Subject in C minor (Alto); Subject in C minor (Soprano)
Episode 9
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 5–6) in part, with the alto's line in the soprano, the tenor's line in the bass, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the tenth). Soprano: a figure from the subject (3 times) and the opening of countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a third every bar. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1 and a figure from the subject, inverted and a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject. Bass: a figure from the subject (4 times).
sections.leads: Between two statements in C minor

Coda
sections.leads: Perfect cadence in C minor at bar 63

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Tenor: free counterpoint. Returns in Episode 2 (bars 16–21). Returns in Episode 3 (bars 23–24). Returns in Episode 7 (bars 39–41). Returns in Episode 9 (bars 49–57).
